Im Auftrag unseres Mandanten – ein Unternehmen aus der Medizinbranche – suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine engagierte HR-Persönlichkeit in Vollzeit.
Du liebst die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Gestalten und operativem Anpacken? Du möchtest Führungskräfte auf Augenhöhe beraten, scheust dich aber nicht davor, Verträge selbst aufzusetzen? Dann bist du bei unserem Kunden genau richtig! Als HR Manager / HR Business Partner (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Personalarbeit – vom täglichen Geschäft bis zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung.
Aufgaben

Du berätst und coachst Führungskräfte in allen Personal- und Führungsfragen.
Du entwickelst HR-Prozesse (z. B. im Recruiting, Talent Management oder Performance-Bereich) strategisch weiter.
Du begleitest Veränderungsprozesse (Change Management) und hilfst den Teams, strukturiert zu wachsen.

Du begleitest den gesamten Employee Life Cycle – vom ersten Vertrag bis zum Zeugnis.
Du betreust das operative Tagesgeschäft und bist Ansprechpartner für die Belegschaft bei täglichen Fragen.
Du pflegst die Personalstammdaten und bereitest die monatliche Gehaltsabrechnung vor.
Qualifikation
Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Personalarbeit mit – idealerweise sowohl in der operativen Verwaltung als auch in der Beratung von Führungskräften.
Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte "Hands-on-Mentalität" (du packst gerne selbst an), verlierst dabei aber nie den strategischen Weitblick für das große Ganze.
Du bist kommunikationsstark, empathisch und trittst gegenüber dem Management selbstbewusst und als Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe auf.
Gute Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und ein sicherer Umgang mit HR-Software-Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich.

Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub und der Möglichkeit zu 1 Tag Home Office in der Woche.
Eine überdurchschnittliche, leistungsgerechte Vergütung sowie zeitgemäße Zusatzleistungen (wie z. B. ein attraktives Fahrradleasing-Programm).
Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem modernen, innovativen Unternehmen mit hervorragender Infrastruktur.
Individuell auf Sie zugeschnittene Weiterbildungs- und Schulungsangebote zur Förderung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Karriere.
Viel Platz für Eigeninitiative und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen in einem wertschätzenden Umfeld direkt umzusetzen.
Ein kollegiales, werteorientiertes Miteinander, das durch regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsamen Austausch gestärkt wird.
Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Als beauftragte Personalberatung freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Such experience may be gained in administrative, professional, technical or other responsible work positions in the public (i.e., Government or military) or private sector.

Such experience may be gained in administrative, professional, technical or other responsible work positions in the public (i.e., Government or military) or private sector.

As a Human Resources Specialist (Employee/Labor Relations) at the GS-0201-14 some of your typical work assignments may include: Serves as an authoritative technical expert and advisor to senior Department leadership, political appointees, and Component heads on significant, high-impact, and far-reaching labor and employee relations matters.

Provides strategic counsel on issues that have systemic implications across the entire Department workforce. Systematically evaluates incoming civil service laws, federal regulations, third-party administrative decisions, Executive Orders, and OPM policy directives to determine their operational and strategic impact on the Department.

Formulates and executes comprehensive, enterprise-wide implementation strategies to ensure seamless compliance. Drafts, reviews, and refines comprehensive, Department-wide civilian HR guidance, standard operating procedures, and technical directives.

Focuses on addressing highly complex, sensitive, and difficult employee and labor relations problems, ensuring all issued guidance is legally compliant, operationally viable, and aligned with Department strategic goals.

Supports LER community management initiatives to foster professional development, knowledge sharing, and standardized practices across all Department Components. Serves as a key liaison to cultivate a highly integrated, modern, and capable community of LER practitioners.

Designs, develops, and delivers advanced professional credentialing curricula and technical training programs for Department LER specialists, HR professionals, and managers. Ensures that certification standards and educational materials reflect the latest civil service reforms, statutory updates, and industry best practices.

Establishes, fosters, and maintains highly cooperative, productive working relationships with key internal and external partners. Collaborates closely with Component HR leaders, external federal oversight agencies, and labor organization representatives to negotiate solutions, build consensus, and address mutual HR and LER priorities.

Coordinates, drafts, and packages formal, technically precise responses to high-level departmental, congressional, and executive inquiries. Ensures that all response packages meet strict approved standards and administrative requirements, executing reviews and submissions in an extremely expeditious manner under tight, high-priority deadlines.
You may qualify at the GS-14, if you fulfill the following qualifications: A.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service: Expert experience writing and developing strategic guidance and evaluating/reviewing policy and program revisions to new and/or existing legislation for proposed legislative changes that impact an agency in the areas of labor and employee relations.

Expert experience in applying a broad range of advanced employee relations laws, regulations, principles, precedents, and policy in order to serve as an agency or equivalent level senior advisor.

Expert experience in analyzing and solving complex and sensitive problems and issues, in order to resolve conflicting laws or other requirements involving vague and untested areas of case laws, where policy decisions and case strategy guidance have impact across the Department.

Expert experience consulting and providing guidance as a technical expert in labor and employees relations matters such as collective bargaining and negotiations, grievances, employee discipline, performance management, awards, and third party processes.

Expert experience developing and delivering innovative and strategic solutions to policy problems in labor and employee relations, including the deployment of training and process change.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The responsibilities described are for the full performance level. At developmental grade levels, assignments will be of more limited scope performed with less independence, and limited complexity.
Serves as a senior advisor to leadership on complex and sensitive labor and employee relations matters, including grievances, personnel actions, third-party proceedings, discipline and adverse actions and appeals before bodies such as MSPB and OPM.
Supports the agency as technical expert in third-party proceedings in Merit Systems Protection Board, OPM, EEOC and Unemployment claims.
Interprets and applies Federal labor and employee relations laws, regulations, and case law to provide authoritative guidance and policy direction.
Analyzes and resolves highly complex labor and employee relations issues involving conflicting regulatory, statutory and case law requirements, policy implications, and agency-wide impact.
Develops, implements, and evaluates labor and employee relations policies, programs, and strategic initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
Provides expert guidance and training to management officials on disciplinary and adverse actions, unacceptable performance, grievances, management rights, employee rights, and dispute resolution processes.
Develops and reviews written management correspondence related to all phases of discipline and adverse actions, unacceptable performance and grievances and appeals.
Monitors legislative and regulatory developments and supports and recommends policy or procedural changes to ensure compliance and program effectiveness.
The qualifications for this position must be met by 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on 07/30/2026. Current Federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the lower grade or equivalent grade band in the Federal service. The Time-in-Grade requirement must be met by 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on 07/30/2026.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
Wolt’s Courier Employment team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet — a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.
The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks. Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.
We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. If you’re energised by the possibilities and want to be the person who builds the playbook, this might be the right role for you.

Croatia doesn't have an independent Courier HR operating model yet. It has support from the general employee HR team, great people working hard, manual workarounds, and a scale-up landing in the next few months that the current setup wasn't built to absorb. This role exists to establish Courier HR expertise within the function and build the processes needed while running the team's day-to-day HR operations.
As Courier HR Senior Specialist in Croatia, you'll own the full employee lifecycle for a fast-growing courier workforce: onboarding, contracts, documentation, leave, and the HR side of a workforce that includes couriers relocating from abroad. This includes tracking of work permits and other integration and compliance related matters.
You'll be supported by the function’s core team and leadership and work closely with your Courier HR Lead, the Workforce Ops team, Legal, and the sourcing agencies bringing couriers in. You'll be the most senior Courier HR operator on the ground in Croatia day-to-day — which means you'll be trusted to make independent decisions and participate actively in building foundations and standards that will apply across all markets.
What you'll be doing
Employee lifecycle execution at scale
Own onboarding, contracts, documentation, and leave administration for Croatia's employed couriers, including the operational HR side of relocating couriers from abroad (documentation, work permit tracking, compliance).
Delegating and syncing with a Tier 1 HR team that handles standard inbound tickets and manual entry.
Build and maintain accurate employee records across HR systems as the courier base scales.
Handle the volume and pace of onboarding waves without letting quality or compliance slip.
Make the judgment calls on ambiguous or non-standard cases that come up, escalating appropriately to your Courier HR Lead or Legal.
Process and SOP creation
Create SOPs, checklists, and documentation in collaboration with the functional Process & Systems Senior Specialist based on cross-market standards and calibrated to local requirements.
Identify where the current setup will break under the incoming scale-up, then plan and build for it before it breaks.
Partner with the Process & Systems Senior Specialist on anything that should become a cross-country standard rather than a local fix.
Cross-functional coordination
Act as the day-to-day HR point of contact for the sourcing agencies bringing couriers into Croatia, ensuring HR-side obligations (documentation, onboarding timing, permits) are met on time.
Work with Workforce Ops to keep HR and operational onboarding in sync as waves of new couriers arrive.
Flag structural risks early and initiate appropriate action in collaboration with your Lead and functional colleagues.
Our humble expectations
There’s no single background that defines this role — but the people who do well here tend to combine sharp analytical thinking with genuine operational curiosity. Some things that matter:
3+ years of experience in HR operations, people operations, or workforce administration — ideally somewhere that involved real scale, strict deadlines, or a workforce with cross-border or compliance complexity.
Experience working with foreign worker documentation, work permits, residence permits, or employment compliance processes.
A genuine ability to operate without a finished playbook. If "there's no process for this yet" makes you anxious rather than interested, this isn't the right role.
High attention to detail that holds up under volume and pressure — the documentation has legal weight, and the standard shouldn’t drop with rapidly increasing volume.
Good judgment about what to decide yourself and what to escalate. This role only works if you can be trusted with ambiguity — and trusted to know your own limits within it.
Fluency in Croatian (C1-C2) and professional level in English (B2-C2) are a requirement. Given the courier population arriving from abroad, comfort working through language and documentation barriers is a real asset — additional languages (Spanish, for instance) are a plus but not requirement.
Ability to work in a hybrid model from our Zagreb office (4 office days, Wednesday optional work-from-home day).

Most HR operations roles ask you to run a process well. This one asks you to build the process while running it, for a workforce that's about to grow faster than the current setup was designed for, in a market where the team is small and knowledge is yet to be mapped to documentation. You will work with a team of experts in multiple countries, giving you a unique chance to influence our strategies, standards and ways of working while constantly learning something new.
If it sounds like the kind of challenge you would enjoy solving, and if you are inspired by the potential of directly impacting the experience of hard working individuals establishing themselves in a new country, this will be a great opportunity for you.
Please note that this is a fixed-term contract until Dec 31st 2026, with a possibility to extend to a permanent contract. We’re expecting you to be able to start working with us during August-early September.

We are excited to introduce a newly created Senior HR Business Partner role, partnering directly with the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to drive organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and strategic workforce planning across the business.

Central to the role is holding senior leaders accountable for their own growth as leaders: coaching them with the same rigor they are expected to apply to their teams, so that as leaders level up, their team’s level up alongside them.

You will help drive effective people practices by balancing business priorities with employee experience and will play a key role in evolving Diligent’s HR operating model toward more strategic, AI-enabled ways of working.

Lead strategic workforce planning for the business unit — including how work is organised across people and AI agents — and navigating the balance between building AI capability and developing the human skills needed for the future in an AI-first organisation.

Hold senior leaders accountable for role-modelling the standards expected of their teams, giving direct feedback when leadership behaviour is holding a team back, and following up to confirm it changes.
Own escalated and senior-level employee relations investigations, acting as the escalation point for higher-risk cases before they reach the HR Director.
Act as practice lead for cyclical HR activities within the business unit, collaborating with Business Partners and HR Assistants to ensure consistent, in-time zone support across the pod.

Experience serving as a senior HR partner to business leaders, including direct partnership with a Senior Leadership Team (SLT) or equivalent within a regional or business-unit-aligned HRBP model.
Strong org design, strategic workforce planning, and succession planning expertise, with the ability to apply it in service of an evolving, regionally structured HR operating model.
Experience leading escalated or complex employee relations investigations and acting as an escalation point above front-line HR Business Partners.
Proven track record coaching senior leaders and holding them accountable for their own development and their teams’ growth – comfortable giving direct, challenging feedback that helps leaders and their people level up together.
Familiarity with HRIS and workflow systems, and openness to AI-enabled ways of working as repetitive HR operations move to automation and shared services.

HITS.NRW ist ein neu gegründeter, zentraler IT-Dienstleister für die öffentlichen Hochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen.
Unsere Mission: Gemeinsam mit den Hochschulen für angewandte Wissenschaften sowie den staatlichen Kunst- und Musikhochschulen die Hochschul-IT der Zukunft gestalten. Dafür entwickeln wir landesweit skalierbare Services aus den Bereichen Cloud, Cyber Security, Software und IT-Procurement.
Damit unsere Organisation weiter wachsen kann, suchen wir Dich: Du gestaltest unser Recruiting vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding und unterstützt zugleich im operativen People Management. Quest is an award-winning IT management software provider offering a broad selection of solutions that solve some of the most common and most challenging IT problems. Quest strives to be the best of the very best in everything we do. We are fanatically customer-focused and are proud to support the most complex customers who have the highest IT demands in the world. It’s exciting, it’s rewarding, it’s hard work, and offers career and personal growth.
At Quest Software , we build technology that simplifies IT management and strengthens cybersecurity resilience for organizations around the world. Our people are central to our success, and we are committed to delivering an HR experience that reflects our global footprint, growth mindset, and employee-first culture.
The Opportunity
This isn't a keep-the-lights-on HRIS job. Quest Software is looking for a Sr. HRIS Analyst, based in Panama, to help administer, improve, and reimagine the HR technology behind our global workforce, including Dayforce (HCM/payroll), iCIMS (recruiting), Lattice (performance and compensation), and the connected platforms that power our people processes worldwide.
This team is in motion: while we maintain some systems, we're breaking and rebuilding others. We're looking for someone with the technical strength to do the job well and the curiosity to contribute to the HR tech roadmap: someone who sees change as opportunity. If that's you, please apply, even if you don't check every box!
This is a remote position based in Panama.

System Administration & Data Management Some of this work is steady maintenance but where you make a difference is researching and implementing permanent fixes, not just quick patches, for broken or inefficient configurations.
Maintain and administer core HR systems (Dayforce, iCIMS, Lattice, and others), including configuration, security roles, and workflows.
Own the accuracy and integrity of HR data through regular audits, validation, and clean-up; good decisions start with good data.
Keep configurations, security, workflows, integrations, and day-to-day system health in top shape, and build or update the documentation that keeps everyone aligned.
Serve as an escalation point when issues arise, partnering with vendors and IT on root-cause analysis and permanent fixes.
Projects, Implementations & Transformation This is the part of the job that rewards curiosity and grit. You’ll spot the opportunity for change and help make it happen, alongside a broader HR team doing the same.
Lead or support module rollouts, system implementations, enhancements, and vendor or platform changes, from discovery through go-live and hypercare.
Coordinate data migration, integration mapping, testing, and cutover as our HR technology roadmap advances.
Support the creation of user guides that drive genuine adoption of new tools and ways of working.
Configure system changes and coordinate release management, including regression testing and UAT.
Help gather requirements so functional specifications are clear from the start.
Partner within HRIS and with HR Operations, IT, Finance, and system owners across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ to deliver aligned, scalable solutions.
Data, Reporting & Controls This work turns HR data into something the business can trust and use, with disciplined controls, clean reporting, and the follow-through to fix issues at the source.
Protect data integrity through audits, validation, clean-up, and controls across integrated systems.
Build or support automated reports and dashboards that meet business needs and let stakeholders self-serve.
Support security, compliance, and audit requirements, including SOC and ISO controls.
Ensure data readiness for the cycles that matter most, including compensation and performance.

Consider these a strong foundation, not a rigid gate. If you bring the drive and curiosity, we want to hear from you even if you don't have every item.
Experience as an HRIS analyst, technical business systems analyst, or in a comparable systems role (3+ years).
Hands-on exposure to enterprise HR platforms such as Dayforce, iCIMS, Lattice, or similar; grit and curiosity outweigh any specific system certification.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with real attention to detail, data accuracy, and confidentiality.
Some experience with system implementations, integrations, configuration changes, or vendor transitions.
A self-motivated approach; you work independently, prioritize well, follow through, and can carry the steady work as readily as the high-change work.
Genuine curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous-learning mindset; you see change as opportunity, not disruption.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills across technical and non-technical teams.
Comfort collaborating across time zones with global, distributed teams; clear written and verbal communication in English.
Must be located in Panama
Why This Role
This is a rare chance to grow from system caretaker to strategic partner while the roadmap is still being drawn. We won't pretend every day is thrilling, but we can promise your ideas will count and your growth won't stall. If you're driven by curiosity, energized by change, and ready to grow alongside a team doing real transformation, this is your chance!

Senior People Partner
📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £60,000 - £70,000
Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised Series B funding, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to ensure we get there.
Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 150 people can break at 300 - and we want to get ahead of that.
This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.
If you know what can impact culture both positively and negatively as a company grows; have experience building systems that both set people up to do their best work AND that scale alongside the business; and embrace AI and the positive impact it can have on employee experience - we think you might do great work here.
Why this role exists now
Our People team is lean - and as we mature as a business, there’s limited capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that enable people to do their best work. We have ambitious goals to achieve - now is the time to fine-tune our People function to ensure the business hits those goals.

In 2026, over half of the business told us they don't know what excellence looks like in their role, or how excellence is rewarded. This is the crux of this role; to build the systems, processes and reward that sets people up for success and ensure we reward and retain our best people.
Over the next 12-18 months, this will mean you'll be working with our Head of People and People Partner on initiatives that clarify excellence and reward - our internal levels framework, compensation & reward, embedding our excellence standard throughout the business, and coaching managers on a team by team basis to increase overall performance.

An experienced People Partner passionate about their craft; curious about how technology and innovation is changing the People landscape, and constantly looking for more impactful ways to support the business.
A commercial mindset - e.g. you measure your results on impact on business and team performance rather than work shipped.
An AI-native mindset: you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you - but understand the nuances of where AI can never replace genuine People Partnering.
The credibility and communication skills to bring busy managers on the journey with you.
Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you.
Why you might not want to apply
We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.
If you want to move into people management. This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports. If a management title is what you're chasing now or in the imminent future, this isn’t the job for you.
If you haven't been through a similar scaling journey in SaaS businesses before. Our People team is home grown; we're specifically looking for the experience and knowledge that comes from having been there/done that before, and can prevent us from making common mistakes.
If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.
If you want a role where you'll be spending a lot of time on pastoral employee interactions. This isn't going to be the main part of this role - you'll be spending most of your time building a culture of excellence.
If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!
We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!
Who are Street Group?
We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.
Our products, Street.co.uk , Spectre & Cortex form a powerful trio, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

# Senior HR Specialist Culture & Leadership 100% #
Das Personalamt des Kantons Zürich ist zuständig für alle personal-, arbeits- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen der über 30'000 Mitarbeitenden des Kantons Zürich. Die Abteilung Human Resources Management (HRM) beinhaltet eine grosse Anzahl an Aufgaben und ist Teil des Personalamts. HR-Beratung, Berufliche Grundbildung, Employer Branding und Case Management stehen im Mittelpunkt der Arbeit.
Du bringst Themen ins Rollen, verbindest die richtigen Menschen und machst aus Konzepten gelebte Praxis. Dabei begleitest du Veränderungsprozesse und Teamentwicklungen und bringst deine Expertise in Führung und Organisation ein.
**Die Stelle ist bis zum 30. April 2028 befristet.**
### Deine Aufgaben ###
* Du führst neue HR-Instrumente und Führungsprozesse in der Finanzdirektion ein und begleitest sie bis in die praktische Anwendung - beispielsweise bei Mitarbeitendenbefragungen, Führungsentwicklung oder Nachfolgeplanung.
* Du gestaltest Programme und Massnahmen rund um Führung, Zusammenarbeit, Kultur und Lernen mit und begleitest deren Umsetzung in den verschiedenen Bereichen der Finanzdirektion.
* Du begleitest organisationale Veränderungsprozesse und Teamentwicklungen und arbeitest dabei eng mit der HR-Beratung und weiteren beteiligten Fachstellen zusammen.
* Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops und begleitest Teams und Führungskräfte methodisch und praxisnah durch Veränderungs- und Teamentwicklungsprozesse.
* Gemeinsam mit POE, der HR-Beratung und weiteren Fachstellen pilotierst du neue HR-Ansätze und Tools und begleitest deren Einführung in der Finanzdirektion.
* Du arbeitest in HR-Projekten mit, übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Aufgaben und stellst den Wissenstransfer innerhalb des HR Managements sicher.
### Dein Profil ###
* Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss in HR Management, Personal- oder Organisationspsychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren HR-Funktion sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Begleitung von organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und Teamentwicklungen mit.
* Leadership-Themen sind dir vertraut und du kennst verschiedene Ansätze rund um Führung, Zusammenarbeit und Organisation.
* Du denkst analytisch und konzeptionell, behältst auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen den Überblick und entwickelst praxistaugliche Lösungen.
* Du verfügst über eine hohe Beratungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz, moderierst sicher und schaffst es, unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen und Perspektiven einzubeziehen.
* Moderne HR-Instrumente und aktuelle HR-Trends sind dir vertraut und du interessierst dich für neue Ansätze.
### Unser Angebot ###
* Unser HR-Umfeld ist im Wandel. Ideal, wenn du gerne mitdenkst, mitgestaltest und Neues mit auf den Weg bringst.
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und eine faire Entlöhnung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.
* Dein Arbeitsplatz liegt zentral und ist vom Zürcher HB in wenigen Minuten erreichbar.
### Was jetzt? ###
Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen. Bitte beachte, dass wir nur Bewerbungen bearbeiten, welche über unser Online-Tool eingehen.
Für weitere Auskünfte steht dir Andrea Bächtiger per Mail unter andrea.baechtiger@zh.ch gerne zur Verfügung.
Dein neues Umfeld: Arbeiten beim Personalamt des Kanton Zürich
Für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen.

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?
Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.
Notre vision
Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.
Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.
À propos de Pennylane
Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

s.h: En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à
s.t:
💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant
💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!
🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible
🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours
🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !
Contexte du rôle
Pennylane accélère son expansion européenne (France, Allemagne, Espagne) dans un contexte de scale rapide, où la structuration des organisations et la cohérence managériale multi-pays deviennent critiques.
En tant que Head of HRBP (N-1 COMEX) , tu construis une fonction HRBP qui est un veritable levier de support à la performance du business : tu influences les décisions d’organisation, sécurises la montée en maturité managériale et aides l’entreprise à passer des caps de transformation.
L’ IA est un pilier du rôle : tu anticipes son impact sur les métiers, accompagnes l’adoption et outilles la fonction People pour gagner en efficacité et en prédictibilité.
Missions principales
Ce rôle nécessite des allers-retours fréquents au HQ de Pennylane situé à Paris, chaque semaine, parfois sans nuitée.
Ce rôle nécessite de parler anglais quotidiennement.
Définir et piloter la stratégie HRBP alignée sur les priorités business, les enjeux de scale et l’expansion internationale.
Être le/la partenaire stratégique du COMEX : challenger les orientations d’organisation, éclairer les arbitrages et sécuriser l’exécution.
Anticiper et conduire les transformations organisationnelles (design d’organisation, évolutions de périmètres, montée en compétences managériales).
Construire une approche data-driven et prédictive : KPIs, modèles d’alerte (attrition, engagement, performance, capacité), plans d’action.
Piloter la cohérence People multi-pays : harmoniser là où ça crée de la valeur, tout en respectant les contraintes locales (cadres légaux, culture, pratiques).
Manager, développer et faire évoluer une équipe de 8 HRBPs , en renforçant posture d’influence, priorisation et qualité de delivery.
Structurer la gouvernance HRBP (rituels, operating model, répartition run/projets) et accélérer l’excellence opérationnelle via outils modernes (Workday, agents internes).
Profil recherché
8–12 ans d’expérience RH, avec une expérience d’au moins 3 ans en tant que Head of HRBP / Head of People / DRH dans un environnement déjà très mature ou en forte croissance.
Expérience tangible de construction/structuration d’une fonction HR/HRBP (process, outils, gouvernance, recrutement d’équipe).
Management éprouvé, capacité à piloter une équipe de 8 et à faire évoluer les postures.
Solide business acumen : compréhension des mécaniques de scale, capacité à traduire des priorités business en leviers People concrets.
Très bonne maîtrise des sujets organisation & leadership : org design, performance, talent, engagement, culture, gestion des tensions.
Capacité à naviguer un contexte multi-pays (expérience internationale appréciée, coordination à distance, sensibilité interculturelle).
Forte appétence IA & innovation RH : identification de cas d’usage, cadrage des usages, conduite du changement et montée en compétences.
Excellente capacité d’ influence : créer des alliances, challenger avec exigence, tenir une ligne dans la complexité.
Rigueur d’exécution : priorisation, gouvernance, qualité de delivery, capacité à dire non.
Traits personnels clés : esprit bâtisseur, courage managérial, humilité, résilience, sens du collectif.
Processus de recrutement
· 1ère échange avec Thomas (lead Business TA) - 45min
· Entretien avec Marine, VP people (1 h)
· Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Marine et Felix, Co-fondateur (1 h)

Understanding and hands-on experience of embedding the HRBP model within a People Function, ideally within a start-up or scale-up environment.

You need the process mapped out before you'll move - we're still writing the playbook, not handing you one

You like everything scoped before you start - here, you'll often be figuring it out as you go

Als HR Business Partner berätst du Führungskräfte sowie Geschäftsleitungsmitglieder der Allianz Suisse in sämtlichen operativ-strategischen HR-Themen und leistest so einen aktiven Beitrag zur Erreichung der Businessziele in deinem Betreuungsbereich.

Darüber hinaus gestaltest und verantwortest du HR-Initiativen und Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Diese vielseitige Rolle erfordert strategisches Denkvermögen, diplomatisches Geschick, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie ein hohes Mass an Vertrauenswürdigkeit.

Du betreust deinen Betreuungsbereich gemeinsam mit deiner Jobsharing-Partnerin und bildest mit ihr ein eingespieltes Team im engen und partnerschaftlichen Austausch.
Bist du eine neugierige Persönlichkeit und bereit, im Rahmen einer Mutterschaftsvertretung neue Perspektiven zu gewinnen und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!
**Das kannst du bewirken**
* Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem oberen Management die strategiekonforme und auf die Bedürfnisse deines Betreuungsbereichs abgestimmte Umsetzung der HR-Prozesse
* Du berätst und unterstützt Führungskräfte bis auf Geschäftsleitungsebene in sämtlichen relevanten HR-Themen und stellst eine faire, konsistente und praxisnahe Anwendung der HR-Instrumente und Prozesse sicher
* Du steuerst und begleitest die zentralen HR-Prozesse wie Mitarbeitendenbefragungen, Lohnrunden, Talent- und Nachfolgeplanung und unterstützt deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung
* Du förderst aktiv die Weiterentwicklung von Kultur und Leadership Mindset in deinem Betreuungsbereich und begleitest Führungsteams in Veränderungs- und Entwicklungsthemen
* Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung des HR-Bereichs und seines Dienstleistungsangebots durch die Mitarbeit in Projekten und Initiativen aktiv mit
* Du arbeitest bei der Rekrutierung von Führungskräften eng mit dem Recruiting-Team zusammen und bringst deine Expertise bei der Auswahl und Evaluation geeigneter Kandidat:innen ein.

**Das bringst du mit**
* Idealerweise einen universitären Abschluss auf Stufe Master (oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation) sowie fundierte Erfahrung im HR-Umfeld, insbesondere in der Beratung von Führungskräften und in arbeitsrechtliche Fragestellunge

* Die Fähigkeit, moderne KI-gestützte Tools (z. B. ChatGPT, Copilot oder vergleichbare Anwendungen) effizient und gezielt zur Unterstützung von Analysen, Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Konzepten und administrativen Aufgaben einzusetzen
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1); Französisch- und Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

**Über die Allianz**
Die Allianz Gruppe ist eines der weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Versicherungs- und Vermögensverwaltungsunternehmen. Die Fürsorge für unsere Mitarbeitenden, ihre Ambitionen, Träume und Herausforderungen macht uns zu einem einzigartigen Arbeitgeber.
Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Bestreben: Unsere Kunden stehen an erster Stelle und im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Ihre Bedürfnisse inspirieren unser Denken und leiten unser Handeln.

Gemeinsam können wir ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem sich jeder motiviert und gestärkt fühlt, eine bessere Zukunft zu gestalten und zu formen - für unsere Kunden und für unsere Gesellschaft. Bei der Allianz stehen wir für Einheit: Wir glauben, dass eine geeinte Welt eine prosperierende Welt ist, und wir setzen uns konsequent für Chancengleichheit ein.

Die Grundlage dafür ist unser integrativer Arbeitsplatz, an dem sowohl Menschen als auch Leistung zählen und wo Integrität, Fairness, Inklusion und Vertrauen im Mittelpunkt unserer Kultur stehen.
Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller ethnischen und kulturellen Hintergründe, Altersgruppen, Geschlechter, Nationalitäten, Religionen, sozialen Herkünfte, Menschen mit oder ohne Behinderung sowie unterschiedlicher sexueller Orientierung und anderer durch lokale Gesetze und Vorschriften geschützter Merkmale.

Für Fragen oder Anliegen in Bezug auf Inklusion & Chancengleichheit steht dir Nani Nold unter nani.cristina.nold@allianz.ch gerne zur Verfügung. Bitte beachte, dass Nachrichten, die nicht mit dem Thema Inklusion & Chancengleichheit zu tun haben, nicht beantwortet oder weitergeleitet werden.
